direction: Original rock/metal album-inspired digital beer covers. Square, etched painterly texture, cinematic chiaroscuro, no text, band logos or copied album compositions.

motifs.name: copperhead
motifs.scene: A coiled sculptural copper serpent rising from dark hammered copper brewing metal, oxidized teal patina and molten copper veins, elegant and mysterious, burnt orange highlights.

motifs.name: mells-hells
motifs.scene: A luminous golden sun split by an elegant dark wing silhouette above barley fields, subtle ember sparks, warm honey gold and pale ivory against charcoal, power and warmth, not literal hell.

motifs.name: queen
motifs.scene: An empty ornate violet crystal crown suspended inside an ancient glass bell jar, thin crack releasing purple light into black fog, poised regal solitude, amethyst and silver.

motifs.name: ai-ipa
motifs.scene: A sculptural hop cone built of emerald circuit boards and botanical leaves, intricate roots turning into luminous circuitry, acid lime and forest green, organic intelligence, mysterious dark laboratory.

motifs.name: maple
motifs.scene: A single giant bronze maple leaf floating over a midnight forest lake, amber sap like molten lines within the leaf, mist and rust red highlights, majestic autumn atmosphere.

motifs.name: ghost
motifs.scene: Two ghostly lion silhouettes made of smoke stepping through a nocturnal forest, one silver mist and the other black shadow edged with violet light, haunting elegant original rock album cover.

motifs.name: wheat
motifs.scene: A monumental intertwined wheat stalk and ancient river dragon sculpted in pale gold, rising over a misty river valley, delicate blue light, medieval engraving meets painted rock sleeve.

motifs.name: bock
motifs.scene: A majestic horned mountain goat made of dark stone and copper veins on a mountain ridge in a storm, ruby and amber highlights, monumental and restrained.

motifs.name: origins
motifs.scene: An ancient anvil holding a glowing amber seed, rings of engraved barley on iron, golden sparks in charcoal smoke, craft and beginnings, warm amber highlights.

motifs.name: marzen
motifs.scene: An ancient oak tree with copper-gold leaves above a subterranean glowing amber brewing cellar, late autumn dusk, elegant detailed painting, bronze highlights.

motifs.name: dubbel
motifs.scene: Two luminous arched abbey windows reflected in a dark chalice-shaped pool, ancient stone, burgundy and crimson stained glass glow, solemn painterly dusk.

motifs.name: bright
motifs.scene: A radiant pale golden river cutting through jagged slate mountains under a turquoise dawn, subtle barley shapes in carved rock, luminous and optimistic yet dramatic.
